note: Export side is factually confirmed: five dated customs export records with destination, HS code and B/L number, all ex-Mumbai (Sahar Air Cargo ACC INBOM4 / Nhava Sheva), latest 2026-02-28. Declared HS 283640 (potassium/sodium sulphites) does NOT match any of the five visible export HS codes (29095050, 29221200, 39139090, 29155000, 28274900) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual observed codes (organic chemicals Ch.29, inorganic chlorohydrate Ch.28, Ch.39). Domestic supply evidence: NOT FOUND — no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record could be retrieved; DuckDuckGo search tool returned connection errors on both attempts, zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, importyeti.com returned 404. Note that anmolchemicals.com is a DIFFERENT entity ("Anmol Colorants Global Private Limited", established 1984, GIDC Ankleshwar) and its catalogue claims are not evidence for this company. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public on free views, not invented. No CIN/PAN verified (registry pages blocked).
